description: Propose the user's OWN fund of several trading vehicles to reduce risk: with no `symbols` you pick the legs (the best-ranked liquid vehicles whose daily returns are least correlated with each other); with `symbols` the user picked them. Inverse-volatility weights. Returns each leg (weight, size, risk tier, worst move alone), the combined fund measured on every H-day hold of the weighted index of the legs' own daily closes (σ, worst, probable net and lower bound, risk tier, time-to-target), the legs-alone comparison, `risk_removed_pct`, the diversification ratio, the average pair correlation, and `build` — the exact POST /api/v1/aib-builder/clone/create body for /create-fund. Read-only; nothing is created or charged here. Past measurement, never a promise; say correlations rise in a sell-off. (no key needed)

symbols.description: the vehicles the user picked (tickers); omit to let NEXUS pick
